recent.title: US CPI (Oct)
recent.actual: +0.4% m/m (vs +0.3% fcst, prev +0.6%); core +0.3% m/m (vs +0.2% fcst, prev +0.3%); no y/y published
recent.note: Beat: Oct CPI hot — headline +0.4% m/m (vs +0.3% fcst), core +0.3% (vs +0.2%) — core hits Waller's 50bp trigger exactly, but the market did NOT price 50bp (CME 0.0%; +25bp ~98%); DXY ~101.9 (+0.36%). Dec hike fully priced as +25bp. Nov 10 NY close: the 50bp tail has grown — CME FedWatch afternoon reads split ~85% 25bp / ~15% 50bp (vs 0.0% 50bp at the print); Dec hike effectively certain, 2Y 4.76% (+21bp), 10Y back above 5.00%. Nov 11 Asia: FedWatch firms to 91.9% 25bp / 9.1% 50bp (Reuters wrap); pause fully priced out; better-than-even odds of a second hike in Jan.
